title: Reproducibility package: Range Errors as Uniform Phase Rotations in Continuous Aperture Arrays
description: Code, trained checkpoints, and archived result files for the manuscript "Range Errors as Uniform Phase Rotations in Continuous Aperture Arrays: Consequences for Near-Field Channel Estimation" (submitted to IEEE Wireless Communications Letters). Running `run` recomputes every quantitative claim in the manuscript from the archived JSON files (301/301 checks).
